newsitem.title: CHINA: Shenzhen Int'l says to place 58 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Int'l says to place 58 mln shrs.

text.p: Shenzhen International Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had agreed to place 58 million new shares, or 2.84 percent of the enlarged share capital, to third-party investors at HK$1.45 per share.

The opticals products maker said 38 million shares would be placed to China Everbright Financial Holdings Ltd and 20 million shares to ASG Capital Ltd, neither of which held any shares in the company prior to the deal.

The company said net proceeds of about HK$83.6 million would be used to fund expansion of its sales and distribution of optical products, to fund its entitlements under the rights issue of China Southern Glass Holding Co Ltd and as general working capital.
Shenzhen International shares were up HK$0.05 to HK$1.73 on Friday morning.
